title: Why do you see lightning before thunder?

shots.intent: Establish the Observer and a clearly distant storm source in the same frame before anything happens.
Fire the light and sound cues from the same source, but let only the light reach the Observer immediately.

effects.purpose: Instant visual connection from storm source to Observer.

shots.beat: Sound is still crossing the air
shots.intent: Hold enough spatial context to watch the slower pressure/sound signal travel while the light explanation lands.

effects.purpose: Expanding pressure wave from the storm source.
Slow moving signal connecting the storm to the Observer.

shots.intent: Make the delayed arrival physical: impact at the Observer, audible reaction cue, and a readable recoil.
Resolve on both signal types in one composition so the viewer leaves with a visual comparison, not just a number.
